Row.Text: Can construct [b] [icon:UNIT_FLEET_COMMANDER] Fleet [/b][TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_COMMANDER_TOOLTIP]Commanders[/TIP] after studying [b] [icon:RADIAL_CIVICS] Discipline[/b] in Antiquity. Receive a Fleet Commander once you have both discovered Discipline and have a Harbor [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_BUILDINGS_TOOLTIP]Building[/TIP] with access to the Ocean. Defeating an enemy with a Naval Unit provides [icon:YIELD_SCIENCE] [b]Science [/b]equal to [b]100% [/b]of the defeated unit's [icon:NAR_REW_COMBAT] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_COMBAT_STRENGTH_TOOLTIP]Combat Strength[/TIP]. On construction of [b]Science Buildings[/b] receive 10 XP to all [icon:UNIT_FLEET_COMMANDER] [b]Fleet Commanders[/b]. [b]+3 [icon:YIELD_GOLD] Gold[/b] per [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_AGE_TOOLTIP]Age[/TIP] for every [icon:UNIT_FLEET_COMMANDER] [b]Fleet Commander[/b] XP earned in Combat.
